zero_k_endpoint_bug: Probe scale was zero when matching.k == 0, defeating the linear sqrt(k) boundary residual; align finite-difference scale with max(1,k_match) residual normalization.
small_k_derivative_bug: k-equation differences vanished at the relative probe; omega row roundoff prevented the old all-row zero-signal fallback. Restrict certification to k-equation signals.
initialization_bug: A forced shear k bump after the positive Picard seed displaced the near-laminar root. Removing the bump lets the unchanged physical equations converge.
